title: Signing in
intro: Depot is where your team keeps and shares files. After you sign in, it opens Home, or the file or folder a share email linked to.

sections.heading: The sign-in card
steps: Click **Sign in with Microsoft 365** if your company has turned it on.
Otherwise, click **Sign in with email & password**. If you forget your password, ask your administrator.
sections.tip: To sign out, click your name in the top right corner, then click **Sign out**.
